description.value: A pilot study examining the relationship between childhood maltreatment and resting-state amygdala functional connectivity in abstinent methamphetamine-dependent adults, including post-hoc associations of amygdala-right hippocampus connectivity with affective and emotional-processing measures.

spans.text: the goal of this pilot study was to examine the relationship between childhood maltreatment and resting-state connectivity of the amygdala in a sample of fifteen abstinent methamphetamine-dependent adults with no history of PTSD.
